method.source: GDELT 2.1 GKG archive and Google News RSS
method.formula: N = 0.75 * causal percentile(intensity) + 0.25 * causal percentile(4-week acceleration)
method.intensity: 100 * sqrt(crisis article share * crisis source share)

hybrid.mode: GDELT archive before cutover; Google News RSS after cutover
hybrid.calibration: robust log-intensity location/scale mapping using overlap medians and MAD

gdelt_method.source: GDELT 2.1 Global Knowledge Graph archive files
gdelt_method.classification: major-economy economic themes; crisis if tone <= -5 or stress theme and tone <= -1.5
gdelt_method.limitation: Systematic archive sample and GKG theme/tone proxy, not a full-text census.

method.note: GDELT history is a systematic GKG archive proxy; Google News RSS is capped and ranking-based.
